rationale: Price has drifted below VWAP ($1712.97) and the 9-EMA ($1712.47), weakening the original bullish thesis, but the invalidation level at $1706.00 has not been breached and the most recent candle shows a partial recovery to $1712.05. The broader market is mildly risk-off (SPY -0.66%, VIXY +0.62%), which adds headwind, but the record Q3 earnings catalyst and still-elevated relative volume (3.39x) keep the fundamental case intact.
